title: 酸碱滴定
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/166_酸碱滴定.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/166_酸碱滴定/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在滴定装置旁，锥形瓶里是浅粉红溶液
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a burette clamped on a stand above a conical flask of pale pink solution, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第四课：酸碱滴定。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts on safety goggles and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 滴定要准，也要防溅。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在凳子上，举着漏斗往高高的滴定管里倒碱液
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on a stool pouring liquid from a big bottle into a funnel on top of a tall burette above his head, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰站上凳子，举过头顶灌碱液。

shots.scene: 小研叫停，指着他的眼睛和凳子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to stop him, pointing at his eyes and the stool.
shots.narration: 小研：溅下来正落在脸上！

shots.scene: 阿杰的记录本上写着从零开始
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows a notebook with a blank page, a question mark above a burette.
shots.narration: 阿杰还没记初读数，就想开始滴。

shots.scene: 一瓶未知浓度的酸，旁边一瓶已知浓度的碱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask with a question mark and a bottle with a known concentration icon, an arrow from the bottle to the flask. No text.
shots.narration: 滴定：用已知浓度测未知浓度。

shots.scene: 盐酸与氢氧化钠一比一中和
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one acid particle and one base particle joining into salt and water icons, a one to one sign. No text.
shots.narration: 盐酸和氢氧化钠，一比一中和。

shots.scene: 恰好中和的点：等当点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance scale perfectly level with an acid icon on one side and a base icon on the other. No text.
shots.narration: 恰好中和的点，叫化学计量点。

shots.scene: 强酸强碱：恰好中和时呈中性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask containing only salt and water icons, a pH meter showing a neutral green icon. No text.
shots.narration: 强酸强碱恰好中和，溶液呈中性。

shots.scene: 流程：量酸、加指示剂、碱滴定、算浓度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four steps in a row, a pipette, an indicator dropper, a burette dripping, a calculator. No text.
shots.narration: 量酸、加指示剂、用碱滴、再计算。

shots.scene: 指示剂到终点变色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask changing from colorless to pale pink as one drop falls from a burette. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室常用指示剂看终点。

shots.scene: 酚酞：酸性无色，碱性粉红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two flasks, one colorless labeled with an acid icon, one pink labeled with a base icon. No text.
shots.narration: 酚酞在酸里无色，碱里变粉红。

shots.scene: 酸用完，多出一点碱就变色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: acid icons disappearing one by one, then one extra base icon turning the flask pale pink. No text.
shots.narration: 酸一用完，多一点碱就变色。

shots.scene: 弱酸弱碱换指示剂；还有氧化还原滴定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several indicator bottles of different colors, a weak acid icon pointing to one of them, a redox arrow icon. No text.
shots.narration: 换成弱酸弱碱，指示剂也要换。

shots.scene: 备齐器材：滴定管、锥形瓶、烧杯、漏斗、移液管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette, a conical flask, a small beaker, a funnel, a glass pipette, a wash bottle and an indicator bottle laid out on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 滴定管、锥形瓶、烧杯、漏斗备齐。

shots.scene: 滴定管夹在铁架台上，管里碱、瓶里酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean burette held by a burette clamp on a stand, a base icon in the burette and an acid icon in the conical flask below. No text.
shots.narration: 滴定管装碱，下面锥形瓶装酸。

shots.scene: 【实拍】装清水静置，检查活塞和尖嘴有无渗漏
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a burette filled with clean water stands for a while, a piece of dry tissue held under the stopcock and tip to check for leaks.
shots.narration: 先装清水静置，看活塞漏不漏。

shots.scene: 打开活塞试通，放空关好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the stopcock opened and water flowing smoothly from the tip, then the burette drained and the stopcock closed. No text.
shots.narration: 打开试通，出水顺畅再放空关好。

shots.scene: 装碱用碱式或聚四氟乙烯活塞滴定管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette with a rubber tube and glass bead tip and a burette with a white plastic stopcock, both checked, a glass stopcock with a base icon marked with caution. No text.
shots.narration: 装碱用碱式或四氟活塞滴定管。

shots.scene: 戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student wearing safety goggles, gloves and a lab coat, an acid icon and a base icon with corrosion pictograms. No text.
shots.narration: 酸碱都有腐蚀性，戴好护目镜手套。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先倒一些到小烧杯，用小烧杯经漏斗加液
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: water poured from a large bottle into a small beaker, then from the small beaker slowly through a funnel into a burette.
shots.narration: 先倒进小烧杯，再用小烧杯加液。

shots.scene: 滴定管顶低于视线，站稳在地面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette lowered so its top is below eye level, a student standing on the floor, a stool and an overhead pour crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 管口低于视线，不举过头，不站凳。

shots.scene: 管尖下放大烧杯接漏液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large beaker placed under the burette tip catching drips while filling. No text.
shots.narration: 管尖下放个大烧杯，接住洒漏。

shots.scene: 少量滴定液倾斜转动润洗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tilted burette rotated so a little liquid wets the whole inner wall, then drained into a waste beaker, repeated twice. No text.
shots.narration: 少量滴定液润洗两三次，放掉。

shots.scene: 装到零刻度以上，取下漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid filled above the zero mark, a hand lifting the funnel off the top of the burette. No text.
shots.narration: 装过零刻度，别超量，取下漏斗。

shots.scene: 【实拍】快速开关活塞排出尖嘴气泡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an air bubble in a burette tip pushed out by quickly opening and closing the stopcock over a waste beaker.
shots.narration: 尖嘴有气泡，快速开关活塞排掉。

shots.scene: 放到零刻度附近即可
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette meniscus just below the zero mark, a clock icon showing no need to chase the exact zero. No text.
shots.narration: 放到零刻度附近就行，不必正好零。

shots.scene: 静置约一分钟沥流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid film draining down the inner wall of a burette, a one minute clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 静置约一分钟，让内壁液体流下。

shots.scene: 【实拍】平视凹液面最低处读数
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an eye level with the meniscus of colored water in a burette, a white card behind the burette to make the curve clear.
shots.narration: 平视凹液面最低处，读初读数。

shots.scene: 读到小数点后两位，记进记录本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook with a blank table and a pencil, a magnifier on burette marks showing two decimal places. No text.
shots.narration: 读到小数点后两位，马上记下。

shots.scene: 移液管准确移取待测酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass pipette with a rubber bulb transferring acid into a conical flask, a graduated cylinder crossed out for this step. No text.
shots.narration: 用移液管准确移取待测酸。

shots.scene: 加一到两滴酚酞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropper adding two drops of indicator into the flask of colorless acid. No text.
shots.narration: 加一到两滴指示剂。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶放在滴定管正下方
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the conical flask placed on a white tile directly under the burette tip, the tip just inside the flask mouth. No text.
shots.narration: 锥形瓶放在管尖正下方，垫白纸。

shots.scene: 先做一次粗滴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fast stream of drops into a flask, a rough sketch icon and a target with a wide circle. No text.
shots.narration: 先做一次粗滴，快速摸个底。

shots.scene: 边滴边摇，或磁力搅拌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand swirling a flask under a burette, beside it a flask on a magnetic stirrer with a spinning stir bar. No text.
shots.narration: 边滴边摇，也可用磁力搅拌。

shots.scene: 滴过头也没关系，记下用量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask turned deep pink with an overshoot icon, a notebook noting the volume used. No text.
shots.narration: 滴过头没关系，记下用了多少。

shots.scene: 粗滴数据不计入结果
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rough result crossed out of a results table, kept only as a reference arrow to the next run. No text.
shots.narration: 粗滴只作参考，不算进结果。

shots.scene: 【实拍】左手控活塞，右手同向旋摇锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one hand wraps around the burette stopcock from behind while the other hand holds the neck of a conical flask and swirls it in steady circles in one direction.
shots.narration: 一手控活塞，一手同向旋摇。

shots.scene: 先较快加到粗滴用量的约四分之三
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volume bar filled quickly to about three quarters of the rough result, then a slow zone shaded. No text.
shots.narration: 先较快加到粗滴量的四分之三。

shots.scene: 滴入处一闪粉红，摇匀又褪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pink flash where a drop lands in the flask, fading after swirling, an arrow showing not yet. No text.
shots.narration: 一闪粉红，摇匀又褪，还没到。

shots.scene: 越近终点越慢，一滴一滴加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: drops falling slower and slower with growing gaps, an eye watching the flask closely. No text.
shots.narration: 越近终点越慢，一滴一滴加。

shots.scene: 每加一次都要摇匀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cycle of add one drop, swirl, look, repeated with circular arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 每加一次都摇匀，盯紧颜色。

shots.scene: 终点要在不到一滴内到达
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single drop split in half with a target mark between the halves. No text.
shots.narration: 最后要控制在不到一滴之内。

shots.scene: 【实拍】微开活塞挂半滴，锥形瓶内壁靠一下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a small partial drop hangs at the burette tip, the inner wall of the conical flask is touched against the tip to take it off.
shots.narration: 微开活塞挂半滴，用瓶内壁靠下。

shots.scene: 【实拍】洗瓶少量水把壁上液滴冲下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wash bottle rinses a little water down the inner wall of the conical flask, then the flask is swirled.
shots.narration: 洗瓶少量水把它冲下，再摇匀。

shots.scene: 尖嘴套塑料吸头，封口膜缠紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small plastic tip fitted over the burette tip, a stretched sealing film wrapped around the joint, checked for tightness. No text.
shots.narration: 也可在尖嘴套小吸头，封口膜缠紧。

shots.scene: 先排吸头气泡；液滴变小
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bubble pushed out of the fitted tip, then two drops compared, a big drop from the bare tip and a small drop from the fitted tip. No text.
shots.narration: 先排吸头里的气泡，液滴就小得多。

shots.scene: 三瓶对比：无色、淡粉、深粉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three conical flasks in a row, colorless, very pale pink with a check mark, deep pink with a cross. No text.
shots.narration: 无色还差碱，深粉加多了。

shots.scene: 【实拍】白底上看淡淡的粉红
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a conical flask of very pale pink water on a white tile, viewed from above against the white background.
shots.narration: 澄清、淡淡一点粉，才是正好。

shots.scene: 约半分钟不褪色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pale pink flask with a thirty second clock icon and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 摇匀后约半分钟不褪，就是终点。

shots.scene: 放久吸收二氧化碳会褪色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: carbon dioxide icons from the air entering a pale pink flask, the color fading after several minutes. No text.
shots.narration: 放几分钟会吸收二氧化碳褪色。

shots.scene: 过量就错过终点，重做
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a deep pink flask with an overshoot icon, an arrow back to a fresh flask. No text.
shots.narration: 加过量了，这一份只能重做。

shots.scene: 【实拍】静置后平视读终读数
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an eye level with the meniscus in the burette after titration, a pencil recording in a notebook.
shots.narration: 静置一会，平视读出终读数。

shots.scene: 用量＝终读数－初读数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a final reading box minus an initial reading box equals a volume used box, a reversed order crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用量是终读数减初读数，别减反。

shots.scene: 一比一：酸的物质的量等于碱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: concentration times volume for the base equal to concentration times volume for the acid, two balanced blocks. No text.
shots.narration: 一比一反应，酸碱物质的量相等。

shots.scene: 酸浓度＝碱浓度×碱体积÷酸体积
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a base concentration block times a base volume block divided by an acid volume block, an arrow to the acid concentration. No text.
shots.narration: 碱浓度乘碱体积，除以酸体积。

shots.scene: 平行三次取平均
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three conical flasks with close results, an average sign and a small spread bar. No text.
shots.narration: 平行滴定三份，取平均值。

shots.scene: 及时放掉剩余碱液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: leftover base drained from the burette into a labeled waste container, not back into the reagent bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 滴完及时放掉剩余碱液。

shots.scene: 碱留在玻璃活塞会粘死
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass stopcock stuck with white crust from base, a lock icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 碱留在玻璃活塞，会把它粘死。

shots.scene: 洗净滴定管，倒置晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette rinsed with water and cleaned with a long brush, then clamped upside down on a drying rack. No text.
shots.narration: 洗净滴定管，活塞打开倒置晾干。

shots.scene: 打好滴定基本功
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of icons, rinse, fill, bubble, read, swirl, end point, each with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 这些是滴定最基本的功夫。

shots.scene: 滴定后溶液倒入废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: titrated solutions poured into a labeled waste container through a funnel, a sink drain crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 滴后溶液按本校规定收集。

shots.scene: 剩余试剂不倒回原瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: leftover solution in a beaker with an arrow toward the original reagent bottle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 剩余试剂不倒回原瓶。

shots.scene: 台面溅洒按溅洒处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small spill on the bench wiped with absorbent pads by a gloved hand, a spill kit nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 台面溅洒，按溅洒程序处理。

shots.scene: 溅到眼睛，立即洗眼器冲洗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student flushing eyes at an eyewash station, an arrow to a teacher icon and a report icon. No text.
shots.narration: 溅到眼睛皮肤，立即冲洗、报告。

shots.scene: 稀释浓酸在通风柜内，酸入水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: concentrated acid poured slowly into water inside a fume hood, the reverse order crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 配稀酸在通风柜里，酸慢慢入水。

shots.scene: 滴定管：试漏、润洗、低位加液、排泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette with check icons for leak test, rinse, low filling and bubble removal. No text.
shots.narration: 试漏润洗，低位加液，排泡读数。

shots.scene: 粗滴后精滴，先快后慢，半滴到终点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rough run arrow, then a precise run with slowing drops and a half drop touching the flask wall. No text.
shots.narration: 先粗滴，再精滴，半滴到终点。

shots.scene: 淡粉半分钟不褪，终读数减初读数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pale pink flask with a clock icon, a final minus initial reading formula block. No text.
shots.narration: 淡粉持久是终点，终读数减初读数。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在漏斗和抽滤瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a glass funnel with filter paper and a filter flask, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：过滤。
